summary: Angled bays behind shops beside the rail line; busy shopping strip, homes 35 m away.
reasons: Backs onto shops, rail corridor opposite
Busy strip with bays full of cars

drivers.seclusion: Retail walls 3 m and 7 m away, no homes within 35 m, but a visible commercial strip with shoppers and passers-by.
drivers.access_and_room: Open road-edge angled bays, all occupied by cars in imagery; a van up to 7.5 m may overhang the bay length.
drivers.traffic: Through street beside a rail line; train and road noise likely.
drivers.convention: Cars park here all day; signed timed bays, so a van would not stand out in daytime but is exposed at night in a shopping strip.

flags: Bays are short for a 7.5 m van
Signed timed angle parking, 4P to 9 pm weekdays
sun_shade: Open bays; shops to the west shade the afternoon, trees to the east give morning shade.

best_section.where: Angled bays on Honour Avenue beside the retail building, opposite the railway
